content.short: Outerbridge is an open-source low/no code automation tool to connect Web3 and Web2 applications.
content.description: Outerbridge grew from a team building client apps across multiple blockchains who found themselves writing custom scripts to connect on-chain data with internal tools. Existing automation tools didn't fit Web3 needs, so Outerbridge was built to simplify Web3 automation with a low/no-code interface and API integrations that boost interoperability between Web3 and Web2 apps. Its drag-and-drop workflow builder lets users connect nodes to create actions, for example triggering a Discord message and updating a Google Sheet when a smart contract event occurs.
